comparison.objective: Close a group lockout hasp through a disconnect handle and padlock it, versus break and recover tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Hasp threading, closure, and lock insertion versus millimetre-scale coaxial tool alignment, bimanual striking, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Disconnect handle is secured by closed hasp and padlock versus four fractured and contained tangs with undamaged retained components.
comparison.reason: The lockout task centers on threading and latching hardware; the candidate centers on controlled fracture and debris containment. Detailed latch/lock thresholds are missing.
